name: AMPServers controller
short: List and control game servers on a CubeCoders AMP panel.
description: Connects to a CubeCoders AMP (Application Management Panel) instance via its JSON API. Lists all game server instances with live status, player counts, CPU and memory metrics. Admins and allowed roles can start, stop and restart instances from Discord.
author: Rezyn
install_msg: Set your AMP panel details with `[p]ampset url`, `[p]ampset username`, and `[p]ampset password` (run the password command in a DM). Optionally set `[p]ampset public_ip` to show a connect address in server details.
